The word "anticipating" is mentioned two or more times in 0.0% of neuroscience papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "anticipating" , 44.8% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This is a far higher rate than the median Psychology paper (median shown for reference); relative to other words, papers with "anticipating" are in the top 98th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "anticipating" tend to be published in higher impact factor journals (98th percentile among all words) but tend to be cited less (4th percentile word).
